Sources.Finding: OpenSSH Client is the OpenSSH.Client~~~~0.0.1.0 Features on Demand capability. Microsoft lists a non-satellite OpenSSH-Client-Package CAB and identifies the Windows 11 Languages and Optional Features ISO as the media for Windows 11; the media should match the Windows image version.

When source content is missing from an explicit source, DISM checks configured Group Policy sources before Windows Update; LimitAccess prevents Windows Update lookup but does not establish that all configured network sources are excluded.

OpenSSH Client is an optional feature on Windows 11. Microsoft documents administrator requirements, missing-source and policy failure cases, and requires matching Windows version media for offline installation.
TelnetClient is the optional-feature identity for Telnet Client; this reference confirms its identity but does not establish a complete offline source inventory for the target Windows build.

CandidateReview.SourcePathValidation: The current lifecycle candidate verifies only that a local directory exists. It does not verify ISO/image version, architecture, payload files, dependencies or source precedence.
CandidateReview.OnlineMode: Intentionally respects configured servicing sources; may use Windows Update or configured policy sources.
CandidateReview.OfflineMode: Passes an explicit local Source with LimitAccess. LimitAccess blocks Windows Update, but alone does not prove configured Group Policy network sources cannot be used when local source content is missing.
